name: Denison Mines Corp.
content: Denison Mines Corp. is a Canadian uranium exploration and development company with interests focused in the Athabasca Basin region of northern Saskatchewan. The company's flagship project is the Wheeler River Uranium Project, which is the largest undeveloped uranium project in the infrastructure-rich eastern portion of the Athabasca Basin. Denison also holds interests in several other significant uranium projects and provides mine care and maintenance services through its Closed Mines group. The company is a leader in the application of In-Situ Recovery (ISR) mining for uranium in Canada.

Officers

David CatesJanuary 2015

President and Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Cates is the President and Chief Executive Officer of Denison and serves on the Board of Directors. He is a Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA, CA) and holds a Master of Accounting (MAcc) and a Bachelor of Arts (BA) degree from the University of Waterloo. Prior to his appointment as President and CEO, he served as Denison's Vice President Finance and Chief Financial Officer.

Elizabeth FreeleJanuary 2021

Vice President, Sustainability and Chief ESG Officer

Ms. Freele is the Vice President, Sustainability and Chief ESG Officer. She is a sustainability professional with over 15 years of experience in the natural resources sector, specializing in ESG strategy, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.

Kevin HimbeaultJanuary 2022

Vice President, Operations and Regulatory Affairs

Mr. Himbeault is the Vice President, Operations and Regulatory Affairs. He has over 25 years of experience in the mining industry, with a focus on environmental management, regulatory compliance, and operations in the uranium sector.

Geoffrey SmithJanuary 2021

Vice President, Corporate Development and Commercial

Mr. Smith is the Vice President, Corporate Development and Commercial. He is a corporate lawyer by training and has extensive experience in mergers and acquisitions, corporate finance, and commercial negotiations in the mining industry.

Brian EdgarJanuary 2005

Independent Director

Mr. Edgar is a lawyer and has served as a director of numerous public companies. He was the President and CEO of Dome Ventures Corp. until its merger with Vicuna Resources Inc.

Ron HochsteinDirector (2005), Board Chair (2022)

Board Chair (Current), Director (Current), Former President and CEO

Mr. Hochstein is the Chair of the Board. He is currently the President and CEO of Lundin Gold Inc. and has over 30 years of experience in the mining industry.
